channel.desc: Kyle is out of work, tensions are rising, and he's suddenly convinced Crystal is cheating; before Dustin passed away, he made one final request: a DNA test to determine if Jamee's son is his, so his name could be placed on the birth certificate; Candice says she survived years of trauma growing up and was forced onto the streets as a teen; she later found hope with her fianc?, Norman, but now her past and his behavior have her worried he's being unfaithful.
